ui.chat.run_controls.job.no_conversation.role: error sentence shown where a background job cancel was asked, when the panel has no conversation to send it to
ui.chat.run_controls.job.no_conversation.tone: plain statement, sentence case, ends with a full stop
ui.chat.run_controls.job.no_conversation.note: Defensive copy: the run panel only lists background jobs off a conversation, so this appears only if a cancel is pressed with none open. 'Conversation' is the product's word for a chat session.

ui.chat.run_controls.job.cancel_failed.role: fallback error sentence after a background job cancel failed and the backend gave no message
ui.chat.run_controls.job.cancel_failed.tone: plain statement, sentence case, ends with a full stop
ui.chat.run_controls.job.cancel_failed.note: Shown inside the job cancel confirmation in the run panel, under the question, in the danger colour. When the backend sends its own sentence that is shown instead, so this is only the generic fallback. A 'job' is a long-running background task (such as a video or music generation) that the assistant started; keep the same word the panel uses for its Jobs section.

ui.chat.run_controls.job.not_found.role: refusal sentence shown inside the job cancel confirmation when the cancel was refused because the provider no longer knows the job
ui.chat.run_controls.job.not_found.tone: plain statement of what did NOT happen and why; deliberately lowercase first word and no final full stop, because the English is a fragment quoted from the engine's own wording map and is rendered as the whole sentence
ui.chat.run_controls.job.not_found.note: Fallback the interface supplies when the refusal arrived without the engine's own sentence (an unknown job). It says that nothing was cancelled because the provider that runs the job no longer has it, so the job is probably already finished or gone. Keep the structure 'not cancelled — <reason>'. Translators may follow the target language's sentence-case convention for a standalone message, but must keep the meaning: nothing was cancelled, the provider no longer knows the job. A 'provider' is the external service that generates the video or music (not the user's account).

ui.chat.run_controls.monitor.no_conversa.role: error sentence shown where a monitor cancel was asked, when the panel has no conversation to send it to
ui.chat.run_controls.monitor.no_conversa.tone: plain statement, sentence case, ends with a full stop
ui.chat.run_controls.monitor.no_conversa.note: Defensive copy: the run panel only lists monitors off a conversation, so this appears only if a cancel is pressed with none open. 'Conversation' is the product's word for a chat session.

ui.chat.run_controls.monitor.cancel_fail.role: fallback error sentence after a monitor cancel failed and the backend gave no message
ui.chat.run_controls.monitor.cancel_fail.tone: plain statement, sentence case, ends with a full stop
ui.chat.run_controls.monitor.cancel_fail.note: Shown beside the monitor row in the run panel. When the backend sends its own sentence that is shown instead, so this is only the generic fallback.

ui.chat.run_controls.wake.no_conversatio.role: error sentence shown where a wake cancel was asked, when the panel has no conversation to send it to
ui.chat.run_controls.wake.no_conversatio.tone: plain statement, sentence case, ends with a full stop
ui.chat.run_controls.wake.no_conversatio.note: Defensive copy: the run panel only lists wakes off a conversation, so this appears only if a cancel is pressed with none open. 'Conversation' is the product's word for a chat session.

ui.chat.run_controls.wake.cancel_failed.role: fallback error sentence after a wake (scheduled check-in) cancel failed and the backend gave no message
ui.chat.run_controls.wake.cancel_failed.tone: plain statement, sentence case, ends with a full stop
ui.chat.run_controls.wake.cancel_failed.note: Shown in the wake cancel confirmation, in the run panel or on the Schedules page. When the backend sends its own sentence that is shown instead, so this is only the generic fallback.

ui.chat.run_controls.wake.already_gone.role: error sentence in the wake cancel confirmation when the wake no longer exists
ui.chat.run_controls.wake.already_gone.tone: plain statement, sentence case, ends with a full stop
ui.chat.run_controls.wake.already_gone.note: Replaces the backend's technical 'not found' reply: the wake already fired its last time or was cancelled elsewhere. A 'wake' is a scheduled follow-up message the assistant sends itself; keep the same word the panel uses for its Wakes section.

ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.title.role: title of the confirmation that cancels a wake (run panel popover and Schedules page dialog)
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.title.tone: question, sentence case, ends with a question mark
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.title.note: Used when the wake is not known to belong to the user's assistant, so the title names no one. A 'wake' is a scheduled follow-up message; keep the panel's word for it.

ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.title_.role: title of the confirmation that cancels the assistant's own scheduled check-in
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.title_.tone: question, sentence case, ends with a question mark
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.title_.note: The name is the operator's own name for their assistant. Avoid a gendered pronoun for the assistant.

placeholders.name: the assistant's display name, as the operator configured it

ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.messag.role: body sentence of the wake cancel confirmation
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.messag.tone: two plain sentences, sentence case, reassuring about what is kept
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.messag.note: Translate both select branches as whole sentences. 'head' branch: the wake's own message, shown in typographic quotes (use the target language's quotation marks). 'other' branch: the wake has no message, so it is called 'this wake'. The second sentence says the conversation itself is not deleted.

placeholders.subject: select selector, never shown: 'head' when the wake has a message, 'other' when it has none
placeholders.head: the first line of the wake's message, user or assistant text, shown inside quotes

ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.messag.role: body sentence of the confirmation that cancels the assistant's own scheduled check-in
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.messag.tone: two plain sentences, sentence case, no pronoun for the assistant
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.messag.note: Translate both select branches as whole sentences. 'head' branch: the wake's own message, in the target language's quotation marks; 'other' branch: no message, so 'this wake'. The second sentence says the assistant's regular schedule keeps running. Avoid a gendered pronoun for the assistant.

placeholders.subject: select selector, never shown: 'head' when the wake has a message, 'other' when it has none
placeholders.head: the first line of the wake's message, shown inside quotes
placeholders.name: the assistant's display name, as the operator configured it

ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.action.role: destructive confirm button in the wake cancel confirmation
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.action.tone: verb + noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.action.note: Cancels the scheduled wake. Sits beside a 'Keep' button, so it must read as the destructive choice.

ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.action.role: destructive confirm button when cancelling the assistant's own check-in
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.action.tone: verb + noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.run_controls.wake_confirm.action.note: Same action as 'Cancel wake', worded as the assistant's check-in. Sits beside a 'Keep' button.
